# appdynamics_role_group_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an AppDynamics RBAC role to a group (granting it to every member). Unlike group membership, this IS reflected on the group's own detail (verified live), so this resource's Read queries the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appdynamics_role_group_assignment" "engineering_read_only" {
  role_id  = appdynamics_role.read_only.id
  group_id = appdynamics_group.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number)
- `role_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<role_id>/<group_id>"
terraform import appdynamics_role_group_assignment.engineering_read_only 2695/77
```
